what: On a fixed WebGL layer (pixi rope mesh) laid behind the screen, ink brush strokes are placed in document coordinates and scroll with the page. Each stroke squeezes one ink pattern into its revealed length and is drawn lengthwise as if squeezed out (3s · .25s later per line · a curve that bursts out at first and drags long at the end). A group is drawn on load, when the section top touches the top of the screen, and when fx:play fires. It fires fx:near at 80% and fx:done at the end. Attach a drawing pad (mode: pad) and, while Draw is held, dragging over 50px across the screen draws a stroke at that spot (drawn in 1s), Ink picks one of six inks, and Clear erases what you drew

options.play: load (right on load) · enter (once when the section reaches start, default) · manual (when fx:play is fired on the element)
options.start: ScrollTrigger start when enter, default ”top top” (when the section top touches the top of the screen)
options.anchor: Reference height for the brush stroke position — bottom (section bottom edge, default) · top (section top edge)
options.x: Horizontal reference — page (left edge of the page, default) · box (left edge of the section)
options.dur: Time for one brushstroke to draw (s), default 3
options.delay: Wait before the group starts (sec), default 0
options.ease: Curve (GSAP name or CustomEase path), default original path
options.mode: pad — drawing board with child draw·ink·clear buttons and inks (slot for the ink-picker row)
options.[data-fx-part=stroke]: One brushstroke — data-d (svg path, box center is the stroke center), data-at="x% y% size weight"(x·y are % of screen width·height from the anchor point, size is brush width relative to the short side, weight is in path units), data-sp (same form below 768px), data-ink (1~6), data-only (pc·sp)
options.--fx-ink-1~6: Ink color. If empty, built by rotating the accent color’s hue (+95·0·-125·gray-blue·+45·+160)
options.--fx-ink-z: z-index of the brush-stroke panel, default 0 — a section meant to sit above the strokes needs position:relative and z-index 1 or higher

use: …

from.where: index.html .c-fv (manual behind the guide curtain · 4 lines 3s · .15+.1s gaps) · tagline section (enter, when the section top is above the viewport) · .c-pad (Draw·Ink·Clear drawing pad, dragging over 50px draws a stroke · dot spacing 4% of thickness · preview is a 2px 50% line)

note: The original uses an ink SVG drawing as the texture and the brush path is also an SVG file. This part redraws the brush-grain texture on canvas (several bands undulate and both ends taper) and the path is supplied by the caller via data-d. The original’s select mode (pick up and move a drawn stroke), ink maker (tracing a photo into vectors) and export were left out. While drawing, the board takes touch (touch-action: none) so dragging on a phone draws instead of scrolling, same as the original. Turn it off by pressing Draw again or Esc
